preconditions.description: Attacker must have MINTER_ROLE to call mint function

exploit_hint: Call the mint() function with attacker's address and desired amount. The attacker must first obtain MINTER_ROLE (either through initial setup or by being granted the role by DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE). Once the role is obtained, call mint(attacker_address, large_amount) to create tokens out of thin air and increase attacker's balance.
